records.topic: general tolerance external radius chamfer height broken edges classes f m c v

records.notes: Do not use for a controlled sealing edge or function-critical corner.

records.topic: general geometrical tolerances straightness flatness perpendicularity symmetry runout classes H K L
records.conditions: Features without individual geometrical tolerance; drawing must invoke ISO 2768-2
records.notes: ISO 2768-2 was withdrawn; use only when contractually invoked, otherwise specify controls under current ISO GPS standards. General parallelism is limited by the larger applicable size or straightness/flatness tolerance; coaxiality is not covered.

records.topic: process tolerance capability achievable IT grade drilling
records.notes: Planning capability for stable production, not a guaranteed tolerance. Verify machine, tool, depth, material, and inspection.

records.topic: process tolerance capability achievable IT grade reaming tolerance
records.notes: Classic planning capability for reaming after a controlled pilot. Tool condition, allowance, runout, and depth can widen results.

records.topic: process tolerance capability achievable IT grade precision boring
records.notes: Planning capability for rigid precision boring; validate overhang and thermal stability.

records.topic: process tolerance capability achievable IT grade milling
records.notes: Feature size and setup geometry determine whether this range is realistic.

records.topic: process tolerance capability achievable IT grade turning
records.notes: Fine turning can reach the low end on rigid, thermally controlled equipment.

records.topic: process tolerance capability achievable IT grade grinding
records.notes: Grinding allowance and burn control remain separate planning constraints.

records.topic: process tolerance capability achievable IT grade honing
records.notes: Primarily a bore finishing capability; form and surface controls require separate callouts.

records.topic: process tolerance capability achievable IT grade lapping
records.notes: Low-end grades require specialized metrology and controlled environment.
